description: This file contains interface and class definitions related to Orleans serialization unit tests, including proxy base classes, interfaces with method serializers, generic classes, and classes handling reserved keywords.

classes.name: MyInvokableProxyBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for invokable proxies with default invokable base types and invocation handling.

classes.name: AltInvokableProxyBase
classes.description: Alternate abstract proxy base class with similar functionality but different alias.

classes.name: GenericGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class representing grain state with a generic payload.

classes.name: @event
classes.description: Class representing an event with reserved keyword identifiers, including equality and hash code implementations.

classes.name: NestedGeneric
classes.description: Generic class with nested class, used for testing nested class serialization.

classes.name: NestedConstructedGeneric
classes.description: Generic class with nested class instantiated with specific type parameter.

methods.name: GetInvokable
methods.description: Retrieves an invokable instance from the pool.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Invokes a method asynchronously, with overloads for generic and non-generic invokables.

methods.name: GetTypesExplicit
methods.description: Returns an array of types explicitly specified via generic parameters.

methods.name: GetTypesInferred
methods.description: Returns an array of types inferred from method parameters.

methods.name: RoundTrip
methods.description: Returns the input value, used for testing serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Returns default value for a generic type.

methods.name: Constraints
methods.description: Method with generic type constrained to IMyInvokableBaseType.

methods.name: ValueTaskMethod
methods.description: Returns a ValueTask<int> based on cache usage.

methods.name: Method
methods.description: Method with generic parameters and aliases.

methods.name: SetState
methods.description: Sets the state of the grain.

methods.name: static
methods.description: Method with reserved keyword as identifier, testing code generation.
